courierTrackingDesc: Paste the courier tracking link from J&T, Vireak Buntham, etc. Customers will see a Track package button on My Orders.
courierPickupShopDesc: Note driver name and phone when handing over items.
scanBakongInvoice: Scan with any Bakong bank app to pay the shop in full. This QR stays valid until this invoice is paid.
courierPickupShop: Courier pickup · Picked up at shop
signOnPaper: Sign on paper; blank lines below if not yet recorded in admin.
codOptionDriverAdvanceDesc: Advance payment for customer · QR or Cash
codOptionDeliveryDesc: Collect from customer or customer scans shop QR in Telegram
codDesc: Option 1: Driver scans shop QR. Option 2: Pay on delivery — QR inside driver Telegram bot.
driverRemitsPending: Driver still remits this amount to the shop.
salesHistorySubtitle: POS sales with seller, payment method, and period summaries.
noSalesMatch: No sales match your search or filters.
salesDateRangeNotice: Only sales within the selected date range are listed. Clear dates to see all sales.
trackingUrlRequired: Courier tracking URL is required to mark the order as shipped.
courierTrackingSaved: Courier tracking saved. Order marked as shipped.
noSalesYetDesc: POS sales will appear here once you complete checkout.
codPlanCollectAtDeliveryDesc: Plan: Customer pays driver QR {usd}. Driver remits {remit} via Telegram (shipping fee {shipping} deducted). Customer does not see this.
codPlanCustomerPaysShopDesc: Plan: Shop covered shipping. Driver generates shop QR in Telegram for customer to scan full {usd} to shop.
shopQrDriverScansBody: The shop does not scan. Show the QR below for the driver to scan with ABA / ACLEDA / Wing. System records payment by driver via QR.
notesExampleCashAtShop: e.g. Driver paid cash at shop...
codOption2aSub: Customer pays {usd}. Driver remits {remit} in Telegram (shipping {shipping} deducted). Customer does not see this.
codOption2bSub: Driver creates shop QR in Telegram. Customer scans full {usd} directly to shop.
codOption2aExample: Example: Customer pays {usd} (items {goods} + shipping {shipping}). Driver Telegram bot has shop QR to remit {remit}. Shipping fee stays with driver. Customer is not notified.
codOption2bExample: The shop covered shipping. Upon delivery, the driver creates a shop QR in Telegram for the customer to scan full {usd} directly to the shop.
notesExample2a: e.g. Customer paid driver QR, then driver remitted in Telegram...
notesExample2b: e.g. Shop covered shipping — Customer scanned shop QR...
waitingCustomerScanShopQr: Waiting for customer to scan shop QR
waitingCustomerScanShopQrBody: When Bakong confirms, this page will alert. If bank confirmed, click 'Money received'.
waitingDriverRemitToShop: Waiting for driver to remit to shop
waitingDriverRemitToShopBody: Driver scans shop QR in Telegram. When shop receives money, this page will alert.
noCodPermission: You do not have permission to record COD payments.
shopQrDriverScansOnly: Shop QR — Driver scans (Shop does not scan)
payOnDeliveryNotice: Pay the driver in cash, or scan the shop QR the driver shows you. This receipt does not generate shop QR.
